changelog:
## cheapcharts 0.1.6

- Added price history timeline capability via `--history` in `deals.py` (`--title "<name>" --history`)
- Documentation updates to SKILL.md and RECIPES.md with new use cases and examples for price history
- Updated decision table: now covers "price history" and timeline queries with the new script feature
- Clarified DetailData usage and ATL flag behavior in docs
- API references and pitfalls documentation improved for history queries
summary: Look up digital movie and TV deals, prices, charts, and recommendations on iTunes/Apple TV, Amazon, Vudu, and Google Play via the free CheapCharts public API...
